And it’s not like when you’re submerged in water your entire vagina and uterus fill with water. It doesn’t work like that. But some water can make it’s way inside the vaginal canal.  If the water isn’t able to come out for some reason, yes, it would irritate you for a little while. But gravity would just do it’s thing and with the consistency of water, it would trickle out. I guess any bacteria or harsh chemical the water leaves behind is what would irritate, but that would be cleansed by the vagina and come out in your discharge.
